name: Sophia University
description: Sophia University is a private Jesuit university in central Tokyo (Yotsuya), founded in 1913. It teaches undergraduate degrees in English through its Faculty of Liberal Arts and the Sophia Program for Sustainable Futures (SPSF).
whyIncluded: Sophia University is among the 10 universities in Japan most chosen by international students (1,503 international students in May 2025 per JASSO, and 422 English-taught undergraduates admitted for autumn 2026), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

programmes.name: Faculty of Liberal Arts (English-taught)
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for 2026 entrants; compulsory fees are enrollment and education enhancement fees. The one-off is the ¥200,000 entrance fee. Taught in English.
programmes.notes: AY 2026 undergraduate fee table, 2026-entrant column: semester enrollment fee ¥30,000 + tuition ¥586,000 + education enhancement fee ¥105,000 per semester, so tuition ¥1,172,000/yr and compulsory fees ¥270,000/yr. Entrance fee ¥200,000 once. The 2026-entrant spring semester carries an education enhancement fee of ¥129,000 instead of ¥105,000, so the extra ¥24,000 is added to the one-off amount (annual total ¥1,668,650 including the entrance fee and insurance). Personal accident insurance (¥2,650 at entry) and the ¥40,000 alumni association fee in year 4 are excluded. The AY 2026 table charges continuing 2024-25 entrants the same higher rate as 2026 entrants, so fees rise during study; not cohort-locked. 2025 row from the AY 2025 table, 2025-entrant column: tuition ¥1,142,000/yr (¥571,000 per semester), enhancement ¥105,000 per semester. English-taught.
